turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Here is one worked example.
I want an egg. First I say "egg". It starts with "e", a vowel sound. So I choose "an".
The rule: "an" comes before a vowel sound, and "a" before other sounds.
Right: I want a cat. Wrong: I want an cat.
Now you try. Write a or an:
She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
